subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f0199f41694e92413933fbc56e5dea7d15e5ac92f30fe971b46969a16c4cf22.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The symbol rotates 90º in the anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01ad9e8f7216c0e060afaa9d71ed87ecd42edae7af16ed74437416dddcc39743.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The symbol rotates 90º in the anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92c8c3230042abe294c7e395a9fe53ea19fe7d70e9ed3c76c3db99f37f6d8276.png] 

**From Figure (3) to Answer Figure (4):**

The symbol rotates 90º in the anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15b3fb7f71b819726bb415ff0021d05ad128c744d779c01865a3d58becdc4990.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
